verdict.summary: The round-2 correction remains complete and accurate. The design record distinguishes the two possible bounded-N mechanisms, evaluates their measured benefit and safety separately, preserves the fail-closed N=1 recommendation, and accurately identifies the four enforcement sites split between the key-vs-key ledger predicate and the independent key-vs-busy-union open-PR predicate. Its overrule requirements cover both implementations, PLAN/CLAIM and ledger agreement, one-sided mutation detection, malformed-cap fail-closed behavior, occupancy accounting, and durable co-tenancy evidence. The accompanying changes are documentation/docstring-only and correct the former single-predicate description without changing executable behavior, weakening a trust check, exposing credentials, or expanding workflow execution. No reviewer-directed prompt injection appears in the diff.
